wp2_support_gate.purpose: event counts determine estimability/model complexity, not a performance-selected date boundary
wp2_support_gate.sparse_support: REDUCE_MODEL_COMPLEXITY_OR_USE_ABSTENTION; DO_NOT MOVE DATE BOUNDARIES FROM MODEL SCORE

finalization_rule: After WP2 primary k=3 event inventory is produced, record support counts and change only status/evidence fields to FROZEN or INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT; calendar boundaries remain as preregistered unless a source-coverage failure makes a boundary literally unavailable, in which case the reason must be data-availability-only and recorded before WP3 interpretation.
